name: Class-D audio amplifier
description: Switching audio amplifier with output LC filter, bulk supply decoupling, gain setting and speaker protection.
electrical_characteristics: Output switching at 300-800 kHz; LC filter at the pins
Supply ripple current at audio rates needs bulk capacitance
critical_electrical_constraints: LC filter immediately at the output pins; speaker traces after the filter
Bulk capacitor at the supply pins; supply current declared
Input traces away from the outputs; ground star at the amplifier
stackup_recommendations: 2 layers for small amplifiers; 4 layers with a solid ground for codecs, microphone arrays and HDMI
placement_rules: Audio input stage away from the output stage and the power supply
Class-D output LC filter at the amplifier pins; speaker connector adjacent
Codec crystal and PLL filter next to the codec; MCLK source close
routing_rules: Audio inputs as short shielded-by-ground traces; differential where the source allows
Class-D outputs as short wide pairs to the filter
Digital audio (I2S) as a group with matched lengths; MCLK away from analog
HDMI TMDS pairs 100 ohm, length matched
copper_ground_requirements: Single ground plane; partition by placement, star return for the power amplifier
thermal_considerations: Amplifier dissipation at rated power into the minimum load impedance; thermal pad vias
emi_emc_considerations: Class-D filter and ferrites on speaker lines; HDMI common-mode chokes where required
protection_requirements: ESD on audio jacks and HDMI; speaker output short-circuit protection by the amplifier
verification_requirements: Noise floor and gain structure recorded
manufacturing_constraints: Audio jacks and HDMI connectors through-hole or with mechanical anchors
unsupported_conditions: Output power above the thermal capability of the layout
